_doc: band mod (Jauge) settings. Override any key with your own JSON file (userConfig 'config', deep merge; keys starting with _ are ignored). Dollars are list-price ESTIMATES from token counts x these rates.
_count: fresh: input + cache write + output tokens per response (what the model newly processes); all: + cache reads (each call re-reads the cached context, far larger).

gauge._doc: Style of the band above the prompt. two_lines (default): the Jauge of the `jauge` block below (two lines of text and the hub buttons, no bar). compact: ONE line, a slim context bar (width px; ticks at the hand-off threshold context.handoff_tokens and at auto-compact, green -> orange -> red) then « ctx 8 % · compact ~16 min · 434 tok/s · 5 h 24 % · sem 14 % » (tok/s of the first scope in `scopes`) and a ▸ that unfolds `sections`. mark_labels: nearest (only the next threshold is named under its tick), all (every label that does not overlap another), none. gauge: the older bar on its own line plus a second line. text: the older single line of band.items. The desktop draws the bar as an Svg, the terminal as text (text_width cells).

jauge._doc: The two-line Jauge (gauge.style two_lines). line1 / line2: field ids in order, '|' starts a new group (groups joined by sep, fields by dot). Fields: waiting (● N t'attendent: Veille alerts marked julian, the only red), todo (N à toi), context (contexte N % (relais = context.handoff_tokens)), five / week (Claude 5 h / week: the engine's rate limits, else the usage mod's samples), codex_week / codex_five (Codex, from usage_dir/codex.json), agents (running on the PC, sections.running_s), convs (conversations that wrote within active_s), tps_all / tps_project / tps_conv (tok/s over band_window_s of the scopes in tps_scopes), cpu / gpu (machine). A missing figure leaves its field out. Each line is fitted to the band's width: full labels, else labels_short, else the fields of drop_order left out one by one; the buttons use their short label when the full row is too wide (button_pad = cells a button adds to its label). usage_dir: "" turns the quota files off. machine.gpu_source: auto (nvidia-smi, else the Windows 3D counter), nvidia-smi, typeperf, off.

sections._doc: Foldable sections under line 1 (style compact). order/enabled: which and in which order (conv = Cette conversation: model · effort, agents running/seen, current Workflow, PR; mods = the Mods button row, always unfolded). The 5 h and week figures stay on line 1; their details live in Cockpit (Quota card) and the open alerts in Veille. expanded/open: the state when nothing is remembered (all folded by default). remember: store (kept across sessions in the mod's own $.store) or session. running_s: an agent counts as running when it wrote within this many seconds.
sections._counters: « À toi : N » (a-faire's summary.json) and « attend Julian : N » (veille's open alerts marked julian), counted ONCE by lib/core/veille.mjs in the scanner and shown once on line 1, red, when N > 0. veille_home / todo_home move the folders (VEILLE_HOME / AFAIRE_HOME win); "" turns that counter off.

band._items: in order: ctx, compact, relay, idle, rates, week. rates draws one entry per scope listed in scopes.
band._scopes: conv (this conversation, main thread), conv_all (main + its subagents), agents (its subagents and Workflow agents), workflows (its Workflow agents), project (every session in the same repo, worktrees included), all (the PC)

launcher._doc: Mods button bar in the band. preset: hubs (default) = the 5 hub buttons of items (Cockpit, Veille, À toi, Registres, Référence) then ▾, which unfolds more_items (Jauge, band's own detail pane) and « Cette conversation », every older mod shown inside one of them; all = the 15 older buttons of all_items. Your own items (userConfig 'config') replace the list as before. One button per item: label shown, mod = folder under mods/ (the plugin name), command = its slash command without the slash, args = what a press passes (optional), key = the open-state id when two buttons share a mod (optional). A press runs /<command> (the mod opens its own pane; band's own Jauge opens directly); a second press, or its ✕, runs /<command> <close_args>. short: the label used when the full row does not fit the band's width. single: true = one hub open at a time: opening one runs /<command> <close_args> for every other hub it knows open (opened from the band, typed, or run by another mod such as the Cockpit menu). A mod whose command is not in this session greys out and says « non chargé : ajouter mods/<x> à CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS ». Mods cannot open another mod's pane directly ($.ui.open draws only the caller's own panes), hence the command.

handoff._doc: Hand-off helper, buttons only, nothing runs by itself. An orange line « Passation conseillée » under the band when this conversation's context reaches threshold_tokens (the RESUME rule, 250 K) or the forecast puts auto-compact within eta_min minutes. « Préparer RESUME » runs /<command> <args> (the handoff skill, ~/.claude/skills/handoff); « Ouvrir RESUME » shows the first of files found under the session's folder, then its repo root, in the Jauge pane. history_n: hand-offs and compactions of this conversation listed in the pane.

context._autocompact_pct_fallback: used only when the engine gives no autoCompactThreshold

idle_compact._doc: Compaction at rest (Claude Code 2.1.299): a conversation over min_tokens left inactive about idle_min minutes. Figures from the release notes as relayed, non vérifié in the docs.

labels.launcher_queued: en file : s'ouvre quand Claude a fini son tour

_shared_lib: auto: per-line usage and prices from lib/core (transcripts.mjs and prices.json, copied into mods/band/lib/core by scripts/sync-libs.mjs); off: band's own parser and the rates below.
rates_source: Fallback only (shared_lib off or lib/core copy unreadable): USD per million tokens, list prices as in mods/factory/factory.config.json (claude.com/pricing). Cache writes priced at the 5-minute rate.
